Rhysida actors use valid accounts (T1078) for access by logging in to internal VPN access points with valid credentials. [E3, E10]
User Account Management (M1018) mitigation: Regularly audit user accounts for activity and deactivate or remove any that are no longer needed. [E1, E2]
Account Use Policies (M1036) mitigation: Block logins from non-compliant devices or from outside defined organization IP ranges. [E6, E7]
Application Developer Guidance (M1013) mitigation: Ensure applications do not store sensitive data or credentials insecurely. [E8, E9]
User Training (M1017) mitigation: Limit credential overlap across accounts and systems by training users and administrators not to use the same password for multiple accounts. [E10, E11]
